tableLines.line: "Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Susan speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
◈ THE EMBASSY — the table is set, the bundle is served, and the galaxy ate from it. The deed is done — the seat still waits on the deeds.
◈ THE TABLE — between now and the seat, the world holds its breath. The wild can still take your food — but it cannot take your people.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Nadia.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Beloved. Strangers ask for your blessing. You don't know what to do with that.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
🥣 Cole of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Cole waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
🧳 Word from The Red Table: Grace is dead, and Jesse and Maya both claim the fire. The Red Table is choosing — or fighting.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the northeast. They carried off ~800 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Nadia of The Red Table with 2 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Nadia of The Red Table didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 800 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Defiant. The System's messages have gotten... careful around you.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Deshawn.

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table II — 2 people, 85 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 10 plants — 9 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.
🧳 Thornfield has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table II. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.

Fresh-cut stems on the north ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table II's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

The north ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table II isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The Red Table II's speaker sent a runner: the north ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.

🧳 A traveler swears The Red Table II, north, is feasting — a whole elk, they say. (They're wrong. The Red Table II is starving.)

🧳 Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table has bound itself to Thornfield. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.

The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/9/3), 10 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 0 · Forage 20 · Craft 19 · Talk 10 · Explore 26 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ THE FEARED — "Look what eating built." The footage plays unasked — the deer, the fire, the ones who came for you and didn't come back. Nobody at the table is comfortable. That is the point.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
The deer. The cleanest kill. The table goes very still. Behind you, your own people go still too — a different stillness.
You let them see it. All of it. The table recalculates. The fire back home burns a little lower.
You spend it — the shield, not the sword. The small envoy stares. Your people stand a little straighter. Protective terror: the table writes it down and doesn't understand it, which is the point.

The most frightening thing you ever did. The table doesn't know what to do with mercy from a predator. Neither do you, quite. But the audience weeps, and the galaxy learns that the feared one chose gentleness — and that choice echoes longer than any threat. The terror stays, pledged now: a shield over every village, forever.
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
